entities.summary: Dr. Hamis Kiggundu, commonly known as Ham, is a Ugandan businessman, lawyer, and author. He is the CEO of the Ham Group of Companies and has written two books: Success and Failure Based on Reason and Reality (2018) and Reason as the World Masterpiece (2021).
